scripts.build: wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir dist 2>/dev/null || echo 'WASM build skipped: Rust toolchain not available'
scripts.build:node: wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir dist-node 2>/dev/null || echo 'WASM build skipped: Rust toolchain not available'
scripts.build:web: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir dist-web 2>/dev/null || echo 'WASM build skipped: Rust toolchain not available'
scripts.dev1: wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir dist --dev 2>/dev/null || echo 'WASM build skipped: Rust toolchain not available'
